Единственный владелец правила, tenant/object/org/date scope до count/limit/aggregate/export, текущие actor/grants; неизвестная операция fail-closed.

Fresh/restore/upgrade/repeat/old-code, checksums, locking и rollback; перед working migration свежая backup и фактическое восстановление.
Полный перевод согласованных UI/service consumers, без stale-context effects и silent fallback; usage evidence перед retirement.
SQL/RAM/latency/pool/cache/exports/jobs на представительном объёме и принятые бюджеты, без необоснованных pool/index changes.
Единый окончательный состав исходников и соответствующие проверки; разные frozen серии не объявляются общим полным CI.
Фактическая приёмка выбранного release/ingress/SSO/callback/CORS/ordinary employee и партнёров; synthetic localhost не подменяет её.
Ревью человеком/согласованный состав/откат; merge и рабочая активация отдельны от зелёных тестов.

negative_proof: Preflight uses the same parser username and payload.client_id as composer; both must be falsy. Basic method only calls _validate_client if client_id AND client_secret; none method only calls it if payload.client_id AND no body secret. Neither calls query_client or returns a client when identity is absent. Machine inherits basic-only, code/refresh/revoke permit basic+none only; no custom auth method registered.

Token get_token_grant runs BEFORE authentication: unknown/password/missing grant remain unsupported_grant_type400. Recognized code first authenticates before query_authorization_code; refresh first _validate_request_client/authenticates before _validate_request_token; machine super.validate_token_request authenticates before checkpoint. Revoke authenticates endpoint client before authenticate_token/query_token/checkpoint.

Code grant initialization only registers PKCE after_validate_token_request and OIDC after_create_token_response / authorization-only nonce hooks. Authentication failure prevents these callbacks. No query/lock/checkpoint/nonce/issuance/FK or protocol writes reachable on absent identity; clean/noautoflush precondition retained. No library parser/auth functions were executed to establish this.

ClientAuthentication raises its original invalid_client401 after failed methods, InvalidClientError renders full Basic challenge; original result_response strips JSON descriptions only and retains library headers/status. Actual canonical result is returned with durable=False; unexpected non-error/dirty results explicitly rollback and raise; no response publication.

Identity-present path entire original body unchanged, including original plan, canonical rows, client auth after waits, ordinary rollback, deliberate refresh-reuse durability and final callback checkpoints. No writer=None fallback for any potentially successful protocol.
